name: Tab Grouper
description: Minimal tool for managing chrome tabs grouping

group-tabs-by-domain.description: Group tabs from the same domain

group-right-neighbor-tab.description: Group the tab to the right with current tab

group-left-neighbor-tab.description: Group the tab to the left with current tab

ungroup-current.description: Ungroup the current tab group. Double-tap the key to ungroup all tabs.

close-tabs-to-the-right.description: Close all tabs after the current tab.
